lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are organized in distinct vertical columns along the caudal peduncle. Moving posteriorly, visible columns contain 3, 2, 3, and 2 blobs respectively, with inter-column spacing approximately twice the diameter of the individual centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the columnar arrangements of blobs, creating a structured grid pattern where the blobs serve as high-intensity nodes within the lighter vertical regions.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature extends across the upper third of the caudal peduncle, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance dorsal pixels to shadowed ventral pixels.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible first dorsal fin mask contains approximately 6-8 small, high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the posterior margin and base of the fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A low-luminance, dark circular patch is located on the lower lobe of the caudal fin, distinct from the surrounding luminance profile of the integument.
other_distinctive_markers: The lower lobe of the caudal fin displays a specific grouping of four high-intensity spots arranged in an irregular trapezoidal formation.
